content.text: Explore the wonderful place of Meghalaya and Kaziranga with our wildlife tour package. Shillong, Cherrapunjee, Dawki, and Kaziranga offer you the pleasure of pleasant weather and the company of rhinos, elephants, and nocturnal wildlife. During your excursion, you will visit Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Caves, Seven Sisters Falls, and Shillong Peak. You will not only complete this trip with a camera full of pictures but also with a peaceful mind and memorable experiences you will never forget in your lifetime.

blocks.label: Tour Type
blocks.value: Group Tour, Sightseeing Tour, Family Tour

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Enjoy a spectacular view of Umiam Lake from its Viewpoint
Stroll around the city of Shillong and explore its local culture
Experience the beauty of Cherrapunji and its waterfalls
Take a trek to the Double Decker Root Bridge
Tour to Kaziranga and spend a day at leisure
Go for an Elephant safari at Kaziranga National Park
Witness the one-horned rhinos and over 500 different bird species in the wilderness

main.title: Wildlife Tour of Kaziranga with Meghalaya Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati-Shillong
items: You will be driven from Guwahati to Shillong.
You'll stop at the lovely Umiam Lake on the way.
In Shillong, check into your accommodation.

days.title: Day 2 : Shillong Sightseeing
items: Following breakfast, travel to observe the splendour of Lady Hydari Park, Ward’s Lake and Botanical Garden.
Later visit Shillong Golf Course and the Don Bosco Museum.
Spend some time exploring Shillong and shopping at the local markets.
Later check in to your hotel.

days.title: Day 3 : Cherrapunji Tour
items: Following your delectable breakfast, you will be driven to Cherrapunji.
On the way see the beautiful scenic view of Mawkdok Dympep Valley.
Visit Nohkalikai Falls, Seven Sister Falls, Mawsmai Caves, and Arwah Caves, among other spectacular waterfalls and caverns.
Chech in your hotel at Cherrapunji.

days.title: Day 4 : Double Decker Root Bridge Trek
items: Early morning gear up for the Double Decker Root Bridge trek.
You will be driven to Tyrna village, the beginning location of the journey.
During the hike, you will come across a lot of residences with well-kept bush fences and lush greenery all around.
As you descend, take in the breathtaking vista of the Double-Decker Living Root Bridge.
Check in at your hotel and have a peaceful sleep.

days.title: Day 5 : Transfer to Kaziranga
items: After breakfast, proceed to Kaziranga National Park.
The evening is yours to spend as you like.
Arrive at your hotel/lodge/resort and check-in

days.title: Day 6 : Exploring Kaziranga Wildlife
items: Have your yummy breakfast and tie up your shoes.
Take an Elephant Safari at Kaziranga National Park.
In the bush, you may see one-horned rhinos and over 500 different bird species.
You can also do jeep safari if you wish to.
In the evening return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day 7 : Departure
items: Have your delicious breakfast at your hotel.
Later, you will be dropped off at Guwahati Airport/Railway Station with fond recollections of this incredible journey.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which is beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business days in the customer's bank account.
